subject: Scheduling: HelioTech dedicated GPU cluster review — fallbacks, isolation, autoscale
messages:
From: Kiran Shah <kiran@heliotech.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: dedicated GPU cluster architecture review (pool sizing, isolation, fallbacks)

Hi Mina —

Thanks for taking the time last week on the initial discovery call. HelioTech is planning a POC (Q1) that will need reserved GPU capacity with strict isolation between workloads and predictable autoscaling. Before we commit to a Reserved Capacity contract, our infra and security teams want a technical run-through of how Redwood proposes:

- pool sizing strategy for mixed-short/long sequences
- autoscaling hysteresis and burst behavior
- isolation guarantees (no noisy-neighbor scenarios, tenancy model)
- fallback policies (model variants, cross-region failover)

Can we schedule a 60–90 minute deep-dive next week that includes your infra architect and a solutions engineer? Suggested attendees from our side: me and Timothy Lane (platform lead).

What we’d like from Redwood ahead of the session: a short checklist of prework (token distribution, typical seq lengths, representative load patterns) so our SREs can bring telemetry.

Thanks,
Kiran Shah
Head of Platform
HelioTech
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Kiran Shah <kiran@heliotech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: dedicated GPU cluster architecture review (pool sizing, isolation, fallbacks)

Thanks Kiran — this is exactly the right set of topics. Happy to set this up.

Quick replies to your asks:
- Prework: I’ve attached a one-page prework spreadsheet (HelioTech_prework_sheet.xlsx) with fields for seq-length distribution, percent of long context (>1k tokens), and percent of traffic that must be isolated. If you can populate that by Monday it will help us size the pool.
- Attendees: I’ll bring our dedicated infra lead (Karthik) and Marissa (solutions engineering) to cover runbook and fallbacks. Ben Carter (Reliability) can join if we need to deep-dive autoscale SLOs.
- Proposed format: 15m context + 60m architecture walk + 15m runbook/next steps.

Suggested slots (PST):
- Tue 2026-11-30 10:00–11:30
- Wed 2026-12-01 09:00–10:30
- Thu 2026-12-02 14:00–15:30

Please confirm preferred slot and who from your SREs will join. I’ve also attached a tentative agenda (capacity_agenda_v1.pdf).

Best,

Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

- Calendar invite: I can post a 90-min invite if you pick a slot — here is a tentative booking link: https://cal.com/redwood/90min-architectural-deepdive
